prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render
Asset type: painted campaign map (one zone) for the home screen of a medieval fantasy strategy game, Crownroad: Siege of Ash.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a flat-colour layout guide; Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE only (do not copy its layout or its interface).
Primary request: repaint Image 1 as a beautiful, highly detailed hand-painted 3D fantasy map in exactly the style, camera angle and finish of the map in Image 2 (a top-down three-quarter view at about 45 degrees, painterly but crisp, warm light from the upper left, rich forests, tiny detailed props, a deep sea with foam along the coast).
Follow the guide EXACTLY: the coastline shape and the dark-blue sea, the blue river course and the three brown bridges, the tan road and its curves, and the dark-green blobs as forests. At every RED dot paint a small empty flat clearing of trampled ground (no buildings, nothing on it) and at every WHITE dot a smaller empty patch of open ground; these spots must stay clear because castles and markers are placed there later. Elsewhere add hills, rocks, fields, small scattered cottages and trees to make it lively.
Zone theme: King's Road: lush green meadows, patchwork farmland and wheat fields, deciduous and pine forests, small half-timbered hamlets, windmills, rocky outcrops and a clear blue river; warm afternoon sun.
Constraints: keep the same framing and every guide feature in place; no castles or buildings on the red or white dots; no fog, no clouds over the land, no text, no labels, no interface, no frame, no compass, no watermark.
